en.w2.pickText: Select some text in the document first
en.w2.badLink: Not a valid link: it starts with https:// or mailto:
en.w2.fontPrompt: Font: Thmanyah Serif Text, Thmanyah Serif Display or Thmanyah Sans
en.explain.fmtCode: Marks the selected text as code.
en.explain.fmtLink: Turns the selected text into a link (https or mailto).
en.explain.fmtColor: Changes the colour of the selected text.
en.explain.fmtFont: Sets the selected text in another Thmanyah family.
en.explain.fmtSize: Changes the size of the selected text, in points.
en.explain.fmtClear: Removes the formatting from the selected text.
en.explain.fmtAlignStart: Aligns the paragraph to the start.
en.explain.fmtAlignEnd: Aligns the paragraph to the end.
en.explain.fmtTop: Puts the cell or box text at the top.
en.explain.fmtMiddle: Puts the cell or box text in the middle.
en.explain.fmtBottom: Puts the cell or box text at the bottom.
en.explain.fmtLine: Changes the line spacing of the paragraph.
en.explain.fmtBefore: Changes the space before the paragraph.
en.explain.fmtAfter: Changes the space after the paragraph.
en.explain.fmtQuote: Sets the paragraph as a quote.
en.explain.fmtBullets: Makes the paragraph a bulleted item.
en.explain.fmtNumbers: Makes the paragraph a numbered item.
en.explain.fmtShapes: Makes the paragraph an item with a shape you pick.
en.explain.fmtIndent: Moves the item one level deeper in the list.
en.explain.fmtOutdent: Moves the item one level up in the list.
